<!-- Write the title and body in English. Follow the development guidance:
https://github.com/takahirox/online-wgsl-editor/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md -->

## Summary

Explain the problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after examples when useful.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results, including failures.
Identify skipped or unperformed checks and explain why. Use checks appropriate
to the changed files and actual repository tooling; documentation-only changes
do not require browser or GPU/device validation. Separate optional checks from
mandatory pre-merge acceptance.

## Related Issues

Link the source Issue and any other relevant Issues. Use and preserve `Closes #N`
when this PR fully implements the Issue and applicable mandatory pre-merge checks
are satisfied, even if post-merge-only verification is pending. For intentional
partial work, state the remaining scope and leave the parent Issue open without
an automatic closing reference.

## Required post-merge verification

State None unless the source Issue requires checks possible only after merge.
Record required checks as pending until performed and report their actual results
afterward. Pre-merge validation does not prove deployment or publication succeeded.
After successful merge and Issue closure, record evidence and any linked defect
Issue using the
[post-merge lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/online-wgsl-editor/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification-if-any).
